<h4><b>GridPath-India: Capacity Expansion and Production Cost Model</b></h4>

We developed <strong>GridPath-India</strong>, a capacity expansion and production cost model of the Indian electricity system, built on <a href="https://github.com/blue-marble/gridpath">GridPath</a>, an open-source power system planning platform for Python. The underlying long-term (2020-2050) planning model data are publicly available through our <a href="https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.dz08kpsbm">Dryad repository</a>.

<h4><b>Affordable Low-Carbon Pathways for India</b></h4>

Using GridPath-India, we examined how uncertainty in demand growth, technology costs, and renewable resource availability jointly shapes the affordability of India's low-carbon electricity transition. Our findings are presented in the preprint <a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.10581">Affordable low-carbon electricity pathways for India under uncertainty</a>, now available on arXiv.
